description: Rb₂NaAl₆F₂₁ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2 space group. Rb is bonded in a 12-coordinate geometry to twelve F atoms. There are a spread of Rb-F bond distances ranging from 2.90-3.39 Å. Na is bonded to six F atoms to form NaF₆ octahedra that share corners with six AlF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 56-63°. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.37 Å. There are three inequivalent Al sites. In the first Al site, Al is bonded to six F atoms to form AlF₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaF₆ octahedra and corners with five AlF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 11-63°. There are a spread of Al-F bond distances ranging from 1.77-1.85 Å. In the second Al site, Al is bonded to six F atoms to form AlF₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaF₆ octahedra and corners with five AlF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 11-56°. There are a spread of Al-F bond distances ranging from 1.76-1.85 Å. In the third Al site, Al is bonded to six F atoms to form AlF₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaF₆ octahedra and corners with five AlF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 14-60°. There are a spread of Al-F bond distances ranging from 1.77-1.85 Å. There are eleven inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Rb, one Na, and one Al atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Rb and two Al atoms. In the third F site, F is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Rb and two Al atoms. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a linear geometry to two Al atoms. In the fifth F site, F is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Rb and two Al atoms. In the sixth F site, F is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Rb, one Na, and one Al atom. In the seventh F site, F is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Rb and two Al atoms. In the eighth F site, F is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Rb and two Al atoms. In the ninth F site, F is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent Al atoms. In the tenth F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Rb, one Na, and one Al atom. In the eleventh F site, F is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Rb and two Al atoms.
